title: Homogeneous $\mathbb Z/2$-Harmonic Forms and Spinors on $\mathbb{R}^4$ from Regular 4-Polytopes
summary: We describe novel local singularity models for $\mathbb Z/2$ harmonic 1-forms, self-dual 2-forms and spinors in dimension 4. These models are homogeneous versions on $\mathbb{R}^4$ whose singular sets are cones on the 1-skeletal of certain regular 4-dimensional polytopes.
